caption.text:
You are not powerful enough to ruin what is truly meant for you. Read that again. So many of us spend our lives worrying that we missed our chance, made the wrong decision, waited too long, started too late, or somehow stepped outside of the life we were supposed to have. We carry the weight of believing that one mistake could cost us everything.

But what if what is meant for you is stronger than your fear?

What if the doors that belong in your life are not so fragile that they can be closed by one wrong turn? What if the things heaven has written into your story are still finding their way to you, even when you cannot see them?

There is so much peace in realizing that you do not have to chase every blessing down. You do not have to force timelines. You do not have to exhaust yourself trying to control what was never yours to control. Sometimes faith looks like releasing your grip and trusting that what is meant for you will arrive at the right time, in the right way.

This beautiful passage is from the book ‘Finding God Every Day’ by Rebecca Simon — a devotional for anyone who feels anxious about the future, struggles with trusting God’s timing, or needs a gentle reminder that they cannot miss what heaven has already set in motion for them. 🖤
